name: VIP (Vermont Information Processing)
old_description: VIP connects beverage industry suppliers, distributors, and retailers with purpose-built technology that simplifies complexity, strengthens relationships, and empowers smarter decisions across the entire ecosystem.
about:
VIP (Vermont Information Processing) is headquartered in Colchester, Vermont. The company has served the beverage industry for over 50 years, though its exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides a cloud-based software platform that connects beverage suppliers, distributors, and retailers. Its system handles AI-powered routing and logistics, route accounting, reporting and analytics, ecommerce, and product catalog management. The platform currently supports approximately 550,000 users across a 50-state footprint.

VIP’s customer base spans the three-tier beverage ecosystem. Suppliers use the software to gain visibility into distribution network performance and optimize brand strategy. Distributors rely on its route accounting and logistics tools to optimize daily deliveries. Retailers leverage the platform to simplify ordering and ensure shelf availability.

The company emphasizes that its technology is purpose-built for the beverage industry rather than adapted from generic solutions. It cites decades of contextual market data and an enterprise-grade AI layer tailored to beverage-specific workflows as core differentiators.
